title: Northgate Tire Center Installation-Day Charges and Fitment Refusals
content:
# Installation-day charges on a Northgate Tire Center package

## Fitment

The Northgate Tire Center installs a package only on a vehicle of the package's vehicle class, with a gross vehicle weight rating no higher than the package's highest GVWR and wheels no larger than the package's largest wheel diameter; tires for a vehicle outside those limits are refused at the bay.

## Charges booked on the installation date

1. **Installation package entry.** The package is charged the package price per tire for each tire in the set, as one installation package entry. The amount is the package price per tire multiplied by the number of tires in the set, rounded to the cent.
2. **Disposal entry.** A tire disposal entry is booked at the package's old-tire disposal fee for each old tire removed, when that fee is not zero. The amount is the disposal fee per tire multiplied by the number of tires in the set, rounded to the cent.
3. **Sensor service kit entry — no longer in force.** The former clause providing for a TPMS sensor service kit entry, at the package's sensor service kit fee, for each wheel with a pressure sensor when that fee is not zero, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis governing how the sensor kit is booked.

## Included work

Mounting, balancing by the package's balancing method, new valve stems, nitrogen inflation, an alignment check and a re-torque check are included exactly as the package's switches say.

## Annual Reward

Tire Center fees never earn Annual Reward; the tires themselves are merchandise on the purchase.

## Fitment truth table

| Vehicle class matches the package | GVWR at or below the package limit | Wheels at or below the package diameter | Result at the bay |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | installed under the package |
| no | any | any | refused |
| any | no | any | refused |
| any | any | no | refused |

## Hypothetical charge illustration

A set of 4 tires is installed on a hypothetical package priced at $20.00 per tire with a hypothetical disposal fee of $2.50 per tire. On the installation date the package carries one installation package entry of $80.00 (20.00 multiplied by 4) and one disposal entry of $10.00 (2.50 multiplied by 4). Had the disposal fee been $0.00, no disposal entry would be booked.

superseded_clauses: a tpms_service_kit entry of tpms_service_kit_fee_usd for each wheel with a pressure sensor when that fee is not zero
